about: The AE needler pack: CMT's TSC:E 1.4.1 multiplayer needler (model, textures, effects and sounds, credited) made into a donor map and the pack, with a latest-generation needler's numbers and pink needles. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

stock_derived.ae\\packs\\needler\\hud\\needler_ammo: layout numbers set by AE, from the stock assault rifle HUD's structure: positions, sizes and references (hud_tag.py), no art

source.name: CMT's The Silent Cartographer: Evolved 1.4.1c source release

tools.ffmpeg: n9.0.2 (decodes the Ogg Vorbis permutations to 16-bit PCM)
tools.art: Python 3.14 with Pillow 12.2.0 and numpy 2.4.4 drew the art pinned below (each by its decoded pixels, mode and size, not by its file)

PINK needles (owner 2026-11-02): CMT's needle glass is blue; its tints made pink
PINK needles: the plasma over the needles deepened from CMT's pale pink

The needler pack's numbers (report section 1): 26 loaded, 78 at first (26 + 52), 104 at most (reserve 78), 12 shots a second from the first, no spin-up, error 0.25 to 3 degrees, aim assist 4.25 degrees to 10 wu, magnetism 12.7 degrees to 30 wu; the held weapon's collision the stock needler's; the melee the stock assault rifle's (every pack weapon melees alike)
the needle: the Xbox model, speed 9.5, range 25, homing 60 degrees a second (report section 1; the supercombine count is the engine's, 7 needles)
a needle landing: 2.0 here and 1.57 stuck (3.57, a latest-generation needler's 7 at the BR's 0.51 scale): 20 needles empty a shield
the stuck needle's detonation: 1.57 (CMT's 3)

the supercombine explosion without its underwater systems and the shockwave ring: they name stock particles and bitmaps (monitor glow rings, bubbles) that the stock multiplayer maps do not all carry, which a donor map cannot have

a needle's kick on the pad (haptics, 2026-11-03): a light pulse on both motors for 0.08 s a needle (12 a second: a buzz), as the battle rifle's rumble-only kick but lighter; CMT's view kick and shake taken out (the view holds still)
The prompts' picture is CMT's own: its pickup icon sheet, sequence 5.
the ammunition panel: the counter of 26 rounds (counter_art.py), the low-ammo flash on it, the prompts' picture off the screen

CMT's interface keeps its crosshairs, now our reticle (reticle_art.py, the needler form: two brackets and two triangles) in CE's colour, red on target, as the battle rifle's; the ammunition panel is the child HUD

expected.about: recorded from a build of revision 3 (2026-11-03: CMT's multiplayer needler, pink needles, the latest-generation numbers of NEEDLER-REPORT, our needler reticle: two brackets and two triangles, a light rumble a needle); a pack built twice from the recipe was the same; re-pinned for CMT's own pickup icon (the message icon is CMT's pickup icon sheet's sequence)
